<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2702_2024-09-1114-42-582" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
      <milestone n="Closing verses continued (only in ID:5488 and ID:7391)" unit="section"/>
      <lg><l>ye shes chen po'i snang ba rgyas shing yon tan pad mo'i dpal bskyed de || </l>
      <l><lb edRef="inst:5488" n="286a4"/> rnam grol mchog gi dga' ba'i tshal du zag med bde la spyod gyur cig | </l></lg>
      <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4661"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos</rs> kyi rnam par bshad pa × nges don rab gsal snang ba</rs> zhes bya ba ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla <lb edRef="inst:5488" n="286a5"/> ma dam pa rnams</rs> kyi bka' drin la brten nas ¦ rig pa'i gnas lnga la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4128">bod kyi paN Dï ta 'jam dbyangs blo gros</rs> kyis ¦ <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5733">dpal sa skya'i <choice><orig>chos ¦</orig><reg>chos</reg></choice> gra chen po</rs>r <lb edRef="inst:5488" n="286a6"/> nye bar sbyar ba'o || || 
      bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba mang po la phan <choice><orig>‹pa›</orig><reg>pa</reg></choice> rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig  || maM ga laM b+ha wa tu ||
